data.title: KSrelief Distributes 160 Food Baskets to Displaced Families in Yemen's Lahj
data.content:
Lahj, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 160 food baskets on Thursday to displaced families in Tuban District, Lahj Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 160 families, under the emergency response project.
    The assistance is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian and relief efforts through KSrelief to support people and countries in need.
    -- SPA
